item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 20/Apr/2025
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Under the influence of an anticyclone aloft, the weather will be mainly fine and hot during the day over the coast of southern China in the next couple of days. With the anticyclone aloft weakening and a trough of low pressure developing gradually over southern China, there will be showers and thunderstorms over the region in the middle and latter parts of this week. A fresh easterly airstream will affect the coast of Guangdong over the weekend. Temperatures will fall slightly over the region.
